title: GODMAN-LAUNCH-DAY — April 14 launch automation script
description: Write scripts/godman-launch-day.sh — the single script the operator runs on April 14. Runs smoke tests for all 7 protocols, publishes in correct order (pact→lax→score→signal→soul→amf→drs→sdk), checks npm publish success, outputs launch status. Dry-run mode for rehearsal. <80 lines.
